description: Related passages evaluation (ASK-X, RELSRC-01 method A). Synthetic questions over the synthetic book-ko fixture (tests/fixtures/pdfs/book-ko.truth.json). Two more synthetic documents are derived from it at run time: `paper-ko` (a question paper: every text block is a question-style rewrite of the book's, which a search would find) and `mixed-ko` (a 교재+문제 document: filler text except `question_blocks`, whose text repeats the book's topics as questions). The related-sources computation never searches a question paper and never shows a mixed document's question part; a question's source reference into the question paper (an import) is dropped. `gold` are the book blocks a good list holds within the five rows; `own_sources` are the question's own source blocks, which come first.
